check_rule: check is the machine-readable form of validator: the closed admission fabricguard applies to the key (C0-4; scripts/tests and the fabricguard key-by-key test read it; scripts/contracts/generate_p0_contracts.py derives it). Every key is admitted in P0 (spec 049 §4.2): admission names the exceptions, 'existing' (enforced by fabricguard code that predates spec 049), 'never' (no value is admitted) or 'P0-A' (a tightening validator that switches in its listed phase; today's admission stays until then). identity_mode names the admission under a Node configured identity_mode: clear ('existing': the clear value keeps its pre-049 admission); under the default pseudonymous Node only the check admits. Keys with owner receiver are stripped from every agent-supplied record. A check with span applies only on that span.
capture_check_rule: capture_check is the closed check fabricguard applies to a reused key on the capture classes its placement names (spec 050 §3.14: the records class, the X05 block on exchanges and run_start); elsewhere the key keeps its existing admission. placement lists the capture record classes a key may appear on: exchange, record (the records input, spec 050 §3.14), loss, the heartbeat kinds run_start, run_end, segment_seal, periodic and final, and manifest (the fabric.capture_manifest span). A key without placement is admitted on non-capture spans only. The records class admits exactly the keys whose placement names record, each with its check (capture_check when the row has one): generated into fabricguard's recordKeyValidators and the SDK's fabric._records_keys_generated (spec 050 §3.4 rule A).
